_doc: Neutral en-us writer placeholders for expEvent_gang_small.json. Keys match zh-cn; legacy keys retained.

en-us.exp_event_erav_gang_small_errand_ongoing: $names$ is sent on errands for the card table.
en-us.exp_event_erav_gang_small_errand_result_: Sent out for cigarettes, $names$ returns to find her skirt flipped up for a thorough inspection, inside and out.
Weaving between the low tables with beer, every table she passes lands a few slaps on her rear.
en-us.exp_event_erav_gang_small_quickie_ongoin: In a lull of the game, somebody crooks a finger at $names$.
en-us.exp_event_erav_gang_small_quickie_result: Somebody drags $names$ to the end of the hallway and is done hastily; the hand hasn't finished dealing by the time she's back.
en-us.exp_event_erav_gang_small_meal_ongoing: Delivery's here. Mealtimes gather the whole floor - the only ceasefire of the day.
en-us.exp_event_erav_gang_small_meal_result_1: $names$ is assigned a seat: some guy's lap. Halfway through feeding her he takes her chin and turns her to face him. "Open. Ah-" - the bite is his.
en-us.exp_event_erav_gang_small_meal_result_2: Chopsticks count as fed only after passing through $names$'s mouth; beer bottles get poured with her lips on the neck. When one of them pulls her over the table mid-meal, the wakagashira smacks his head - "It's dinner! Leave it. Finish eating first!"
en-us.exp_event_erav_gang_small_meal_result_3: Her own bento portion she's allowed to eat herself. The whole table watching makes her chopsticks slower and slower - "Eat, will ya. ...Wait, no - my drumstick first."
en-us.exp_event_erav_gang_small_bath_ongoing: At the group bath held every two days, $names$ is required to scrub every man's back.
en-us.exp_event_erav_gang_small_bath_result_1: Kneeling in the bathhouse working down the line, scrub after scrub, she is seized wherever the hand happens to be - "Soaking just does this to me. Can't help it."
en-us.exp_event_erav_gang_small_bath_result_2: Splashing and urging echo through the steam: "Water's getting cold - hurry up!" By the time the bath ends, the bunkroom's next round is already waiting.
en-us.exp_event_erav_gang_small_night_ongoing: Lights out: $names$ sleeps in the dead center of the bunks - the wakagashira's rule, 'for the guys who need her at night'.
en-us.exp_event_erav_gang_small_night_result_1: Shaken awake in the small hours, she is arranged and entered half-asleep. When it's over he pats her hip and is snoring before she settles.
en-us.exp_event_erav_gang_small_night_result_2: "...Mm..." "Shh. Sleep." She saves the strength of opening her eyes, her body meeting the motion on its own - and before dawn, the next one in line is waiting.
en-us.exp_event_erav_gang_small_quickie_result: Somebody drags $names$ to the end of the hallway and is done hastily; the hand hasn't finished dealing by the time she's back.
